display.summary: Faster, snapshot-consistent system backups you can cancel, with a choice of encryption and a portable project-data scope, on top of 1.11.0b2.
highlights: System backups run several times faster on large tables and encrypt while they are written.
On PostgreSQL a backup is one point-in-time snapshot while the site keeps working.
Choose server-key, passphrase or no encryption, and optionally a portable project-data-only backup.
Cancel a running backup, see its live console and time left; only one backup runs at a time.
Database migration: additive and inline-safe (new backup options columns).
